title: Initiation, Human and Solar
author: Alice A. Bailey
description: Alice A. Bailey presents an esoteric account of initiation as a process of spiritual development. The work describes stages, relationships and hierarchies within the modern occult cosmology associated with her teachings.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/initiationhuman00bail).
